migration_blockers.what: comms validates recipients against roles/* in the checkout it runs from. Run from the canonical checkout, which the working contract says is never pulled, it rejected a newer seat (Odysseus): 'unknown recipients'. It works from an up-to-date worktree.
evidence: 2026-09-28 post attempt from c:/Prometheus failed; retried from worktree -> #917

migration_blockers.what: A frozen unit that takes --out on its command line cannot know FABRIC_OUT_DIR in advance, so results travel as an untracked file inside changes.patch.
fabric submit does not check that --base resolves. A mistyped SHA fails only at claim time and burns max_attempts.
